d:
Kashmir mairathan ke tisre edishan men do hazar se zyada neshnal aur intarneshnal ethliton ne hissa liya.lekin is mairathan men sabse zyada charcha gujrat ki ek mahila ki huee, jinki shadi kashmir ke ek parivar men huee hai.
Is mahila ka nam hai kulsum bano.vah apne ek sal ke bete ko sine men bandhkar haf mairathan daurin. unki tasviren aur vidiyo soshal midiya par vayral ho gae.
Sunie kulsum bano, is par kya kah rahi hain.
